text: My boy, you are looking quite dapper. You must try the<65534>brown rice tea. It's simply divine.<65535>
Such a gentleman. So I hear you've been doing well for<65534>yourself. <65535>
Hmm... Indeed, I am. To the contrary, I hear you're not<65534>fairing so well. <65535>
Ha! Well, you heard wrong.<65535>
Lord Masamune. He's just a weasel. Don't waste your<65534>time.<65535>
Locking horns with him will only sour the name of the<65534>One-Eyed Dragon. Moving forward with our plan would be<65534>the wisest course of --<65535>
I heard that Kojuro! I refuse to pardon such words!<65535>
Then it worked. I intended for you to hear it.<65535>
You try my civility! Come on and show me what you've<65534>got!<65535>
That's something I can do, no problem. Are you ready<65534>for this?<65535>
Mitsunari... Ishida...!<65535>
And you are...?<65535>

Long time no see, Mitsunari. I was just headed your<65534>way. It must mean something approaching destiny to<65534>cross paths with you here again. <65530><530><65533>I'm assuming you're here looking for an alliance<65534>with Yukimura.<65535>
Which is great. That'll save me the trouble of going<65534>all the way to Osaka. Because right here, I'm gonna pay<65534>you back for last time.<65535>
Good for you. Who are you?<65535>
What...the hell?<65535>
How many times must I say it? I don't know who you are.<65535>
You bastard... You forgot about Odawara?!<65535>
Odawara. Difficult, yes, but in much better times. For<65534>Lord Hideyoshi, I fought that battle with everything I<65534>had to give. To this day, I still consider it an honor.<65535>
During that time, there was a man whom I defeated. How<65534>could I remember his face now? Go away, you annoy me.<65535>
Yukimura...?!<65535>
Get outta here, Yukimura!<65535>
No!  I, Yukimura, cannot allow you to injure our friend<65534>in  Ueda Castle. Defy me and face the consequences!<65535>
Oh, yeah? Then let me go ahead and take care of you<65534>first!<65535>
Let's settle this once and for all...!<65535>
Lord Masamune, that's enough...<65535>
Kojuro, go away.<65535>
I will not... this match is over.<65535>
It's not over...until this blade crosses Mitsunari's<65534>throat.<65535>
You have to cease this all consuming anger... I've<65534>tried to tell you. Do you truly wish to end this by<65534>killing Yukimura? <65535>
Are you disobeying my order?!<65535>

I live for my vow! I swore that oath! I swore that I<65534>would never allow you to regret another decision!<65530><508><65533>And if I fail in keeping to my word, then you may<65534>as well do as you please with my life!<65535>
You and I will end this another time. Until then, you<65534>may live your life.<65535>
Are you... going after Mitsunari?<65535>
Yeah, that is my intention.<65535>

I too intend to defeat Ieyasu... Even the dreams that<65534>come to me in the night pain me, knowing he's still<65534>out there.<65530><428><65533>I look forward to the future, Masamune, when you and<65534>I will do battle again and to a more fitting end.<65535>
When and as you wish, Yukimura Sanada.<65535>
I thought as much. There's not another man anywhere who<65534>can match your skills. <65535>
I appreciate the sentiment, but the world's a big<65534>place, full of fighters who could take me on.<65535>
What happened to you, One-Eyed Dragon? We've traded<65534>many words between us, but this is the first time I've<65534>had a sense of what is on your mind.<65535>
Not likely.<65535>
So, about your conditions and such.<65535>
I mean, from the outset, I've always considered the two<65534>of us equals. Did you have a different opinion?<65535>
So it's not only your body that's grown since the last<65534>time we met. <65535>
Huh? What does that mean? Is that a jab?!<65535>
I won't repeat myself. You should listen more<65534>carefully. One of these days, I'm gonna outclass you. <65535>
I must get used to this temperament of yours!<65535>
Have you and I met before...?<65535>
Yes, you defeated me at Odawara.<65535>
Oh? That was you? How funny. So that must be why you've<65534>come here. Seeking another defeat.<65535>
Talk all you want. I don't care. I'm not here seeking<65534>any kind of vengeance.<65535>
I just wanted to tell you that you're nothing but a<65534>mark in the road. In other words...<65535>
Go to Hell. Got it?<65535>
I don't care about the nonsense you spout. But if your<65534>goal is to get yourself killed,I will gladly make sure<65534>that mouth of yours stays shut for eternity.<65535>
Now, it's getting interesting. Show me what you've got,<65534>Mitsunari Ishida!<65535>
How did I lose...to you of all people...<65535>
I haven't... Ieyasu...<65535>
Lord Hideyoshi...<65535>
So did you forgive him?<65535>
Forgive him? Hmph. I'm hardly that commendable a man.<65535>
His eyes, I've seen them somewhere before... I know I<65534>have...<65535>
Yes... They're just like yours.<65535>
Hell is not a place anyone wants to go, dead or<65534>otherwise. To crawl your way outta there you need a lot<65534>of luck or something else...<65535>
Lord Masamune?<65535>
This isn't like me at all.<65535>
Kojuro! Let's get outta here.<65535>
Yes, my Lord!<65535>
So, this is it. We've finally reached the turning<65534>point.<65535>
Kojuro!<65535>
My Lord!<65535>
What's the deal with Yukimura Sanada?<65535>
According to reports, he's taken the long way to<65534>Kyushu. He's sought advice from Shimazu the Beast and<65534>has now stepped up plans to revive the Takeda Clan.<65535>
Kyushu, huh? Such an irresponsible man.<65535>
Yukimura must have sought out Shimazu the Beast, in<65534>order to inherit the old traditions.<65535>

All things old disappear. But it's never a bad idea to<65534>take the best with you into the future.<65530><326><65533>If he who bears the burden has to struggle in his<65534>ventures, then he must not waver on his path toward<65534>the future.<65535>
Unification is next. Old and new alike. I will claim<65534>everything in the land and rule it as my own!<65535>
I understand that to conquer the country, the younger<65534>generation must strike down the legends such as myself.<65535>

I've got it! And I've made up my mind! For the youth<65534>who carry the burden of the future upon their<65534>shoulders,<65530><599><65533>I will peaceably retire granting all I have<65534>to your cause.<65535>
What do we do?<65535>
That would be your decision...<65535>
I say we leave.<65535>
Wait! Stop right there! I can advise you! <65535>
Doesn't that sound like an excellent idea, Masamune my<65534>boy? I don't think you'll get a better offer around<65534>these parts then that! Ah!<65535>
So... I suppose this is it.<65535>
Wanna tell me what you've learned from all this?<65535>
To walk my own path. How about you?<65535>
Hmmm... As for me...<65535>
I really don't think I'm going to tell you that.<65535>
In that case...!<65535>
I guess I'll have to beat the answer out of you!<65535>
Prepare to meet your end!<65535>
Looks like it's a tie to me. Well, Yukimura, guess<65534>we'll have to wait for some other time to settle this<65534>score. <65535>
Masamune?<65535>
Goodbye.<65535>
Lord Masamune, I thought this was going to be the end<65534>of it. Why let him go?<65535>
You still don't get it, do you, Kojuro? When the new<65534>era dawns, I want to make sure he's there so I can have<65534>some fun at his expense.<65535>
Oh, of course. Why not?<65535>
Yeah. You're coming around. <65535>
Yukimura Sanada... I look forward to the next time we<65534>meet. <65535>
Defend yourself!<65535>
Well, I'd really like to stay... but I've got some<65534>business. <65535>
Just remember... Raw force isn't the answer to every<65534>problem. That's a lesson I had to learn a long time<65534>back. Be seeing you. <65535>
Don't you get it, General? He carries the<65534>responsibility of a whole land on his shoulders, but he<65534>commands by standing on his own two feet.<65535>
Yes... I have much to learn from him.<65535>
Aw, no... You don't get it. The One-Eyed Dragon has<65534>nothing to teach you. Just do things your own way...<65534>And besides...<65535>
It's like this. I really don't care for the guy... and<65534>I'd hate to see you start acting like him.<65535>
That's right, Yukimura. Wallow in your shame. Your<65534>tears provide nourishment for your growth.<65535>
And then... be proud of yourself. For you were chosen<65534>by the Tiger of Kai... to care for Takeda.<65535>
Aghh... But-- but...<65535>
Listen closely. The Tiger of Kai had faith in<65534>himself... You must learn to have faith in yourself.<65535>
So... I will be accompanying you.<65535>
K--Kenshin! What are you saying?<65535>

If you lose faith during the battle... You must find<65534>the Tiger in me.<65530><353><65533>Through the countless battles... The spirit which is<65534>the Tiger has found a home within my heart. And it<65534>has found one... in your heart as well. True, yes?<65535>
My Lord... I ask you now for your blessing... and for<65534>the strength I will need in order to carry out your<65534>will...!<65535>
If I just win this battle... then perhaps that dream<65534>will no longer trouble me...<65535>
"Reclaim your soul," huh?<65535>
Ieyasu... I still can't understand. How did you and<65534>I... turn out so different?<65535>
The reason for that is you haven't become... the man<65534>that you're supposed to be.<65535>
I... What do you mean...?<65535>
Why do you seek to do battle with me?<65535>
Because... I must respect the will of my Lord...<65535>
Yukimura... Lord Shingen wanted to find a young man who<65534>knew how to follow his own heart. He wanted to be a<65534>mentor to that young man.<65535>
My heart...? What do you mean...?<65535>
You've always acted like you thought Lord Shingen would<65534>act. But... you are not Shingen.<65535>
I know that in your heart, there is a desire, something<65534>that speaks to you... Yukimura, the time has come...<65535>
To reclaim your soul!<65535>
Yukimura! Reclaim your soul!<65535>
Reclaim your soul!<65535>
I hear him... and his spirit is within me! The spirit<65534>of Shingen Takeda!<65535>
Then talk is done. In the name of peace... I shall not<65534>welcome defeat! <65535>
I'm ready to fight! Not by the will of another... but<65534>because it is what I want!<65535>
What a spirit... Lord Shingen has given to you...!<65535>
Listen, Yukimura... I could really use some help. If<65534>you were to join forces with me, I would be most<65534>grateful.<65535>
Ieyasu. At last I recognize the truth. Even if my life<65534>were taken from me, there is a spirit present in my<65534>heart... and it will live forever.<65535>
That is the spirit of Takeda. And I will protect it...<65534>no matter what may happen.<65535>
Even if I were given half of this world, my beliefs<65534>would not ever change! My will, my passion and<65534>conviction... let them resound, across this land!<65535>
That's it... The spirit of the Tiger.<65535>
I believe that some day soon the two of us will again<65534>meet in battle.<65535>
Shimazu the Beast! I am absolutely certain... that you<65534>will come to see things my way!<65535>
Sorry... But I'm not going to give you any help.<65535>
What? But why...? It is true... that because of my<65534>inexperience, Takeda's reputation is tarnished... But<65534>still...!<65535>
You haven't figured it out, have you? The truth is,<65534>son... you don't need help from me.<65535>
Look. It's just the fact. Everyone is doing everything<65534>they can to support you. Even a blind man could see<65534>that.<65535>
But... that's not...!<65535>

"Yukimura is the finest samurai there is. Not even the<65534>ancient legends tell of one matching the honor he has<65534>won."<65530><628><65533>A good General must always first win the hearts<65534>of his people.<65535>
Yoshihiro...!<65535>
Listen, Yukimura! You should be proud. Takeda's<65534>reputation has not lost one ounce of its shine!<65535>
I am filled with energy...! I feel as though I could<65534>run through the world forever!<65535>
It must be the blessings of my Lord that drive me<65534>forward! I can almost hear his words encouraging me!<65535>
Proceed, Yukimura! Like a great fire... shall you<65534>spread!<65535>
Yes, my Lord! I hear your words, and I'm ready to act!<65534>May your blessings guide me!<65535>
I am watching over you... Yukimuraaa!<65535>
No, no, my Lord!! How could you be there--???!!!<65535>
I am indeed your Lord. My illness... is driven away!<65535>
Harken, Yukimura! There is nothing to worry about! Not<65534>any longer! Go show them the wings of the Tiger!<65535>
I like your spirit! Your passion!<65535>
Likewise, Masamune. Your swordsmanship has improved.<65534>You're even greater than before...!<65535>
Of course... 'Cause you know, not gonna wait around<65534>without getting a little practice in!<65535>
Finally, I arrived here after so many journeys... after<65534>walking so many paths...!<65535>
If I should fall... it's only so I can rise again!!<65535>
Your challenge... is accepted!<65535>
Come on! Last one standing... Will it be you?! Or me?!<65535>
Ieyasu!! <65535>
You came to the Saica...as I did!<65535>
None of that matters anymore. Prepare yourself<65534>Ieyasu,<95>I'm going to kill you, here and now!!But you...<65535>
...Magoichi Saica... You stay out of this!<65535>
You forget this is our land, and you are an intruder.<65535>
Ieyasu! Don't you dare run away!<65535>
Magoichi... how dare you...<65535>
What? Do you have something to say to me?<65535>
Lord Hideyoshi... Please, grant me permission to kill<65534>her...<65535>
You're going to say it.  "I will deny Ieyasu's<65534>request." <65535>
Your life depends on it... SAY IT!<65535>
Stop it! I'll say it! I will deny Ieyasu's request!<65535>
I despise nothing more than betrayal... You are going<65534>to turn your loyalties against Ieyasu... You will make<65534>certain he feels the sting of your treachery! <65535>
Hate him! hurt him! Torture him! Destroy him!<65535>
Ow! I'm sorry!<65535>
Well done... Now I'm sure an alliance with you will<65534>succeed.<65535>
I respect you, Mitsunari. You're a man who lives by his<65534>principals.<65535>
Truly... I don't think your half as wicked as your<65534>reputation.<65535>
But I think your reputation suits you well! In you<65534>eyes, I see no hatred! Ieyasu shouldn't have sent such<65534>a poor liar!<65535>
I do not lie. To have my revenge, I'll do what must be<65534>done.<65535>

They look to him for guidance, hanging on his every<65534>word.  They bow to his every whim!<65530><367><65533>and what they cannot give the fates present before him!<65534>That smug creature took everything away from me!<65535>
Ieyasu... I will never forgive you for what you have<65534>done!<65535>
I'm not going to repeat myself. I give orders, you obey<65534>without question.<65535>
As you wish. I suppose we're both allied to Yoshitsugu.<65534><65535>
Tell me, where does all that rage come from?<65535>
I don't know what you mean.<65535>
That is remarkable. You have no idea what you are. You<65534>really are that ignorant. <65535>
If I were to die, You would stand alone against Ieyasu.<65534>So go ahead and kill me..<65535>
Ridiculous... How much longer must I wait?<65535>
Have patience, Mitsunari.<65535>
I can bear it no longer! It's time! And don't you dare<65534>try and stop me! <65535>
Enough! I've had enough! Finally I can say how much I<65534>hate you! I won't betray Ieyasu no matter what! So go<65534>away! The only person I'd betray, is Mitsunari!<65535>
You traitorous cur... <65535>
Ieyasu!! I'll kill you!!!<65535>
Though you have assembled a mighty army... And though<65534>you have spoken you pretty speeches... Even now... I<65534>still see right through you.<65535>
Ieyasu... Your sins have found you out!<65535>
Mitsunari...<65535>
Now... Bow down in reverence to Lord Hideyoshi!  Beg<65534>his forgiveness for your crimes! And then, offer up<65534>your life as penance!<65535>
I cannot. My cause is righteous.<65535>

It always has to be this way dealing with you, doesn't<65534>it?<65530><307><65533>You ignore your own ambitions Pretending to cling<65534>to your moral superiority While challenging Lord<65534>Hideyoshi's dreams of unification!<65535>
You are deluded, Mitsunari! But know this...! I will<65534>unite this country with or without you!<65535>

How much will it take before your satisfied!? How<65534>much?! Even the very last of my allies you woo to your<65534>side with your forked tongue!<65530><742><65533>How am I supposed to live? What am I supposed to do now?!<65535>
Go ahead, Mitsunari. Fight with all the strength you<65534>have! But know this- I will never admit defeat, or<65534>surrender!<65530><658><65533>I can't fail! I will have peace for my power...<65535>
...Is the strength of all!<65535>
He's dead... I did it! Lord Hideyoshi! I did it!<65535>
It's just... It's empty...<65535>
Hey get up.<65535>
You dare disobey? Get up. I command you to rise to your<65534>feet so that I can kill you again!<65535>
You had to die... I killed you in Lord Hideyoshi's<65534>name... You're death was in service to Lord Hideyoshi..<65535>
Wasn't it? But why is it that now that you are gone? My<65534>life seems to have lost it's meaning. <65535>
I have been a fool! I must go and beg forgiveness for<65534>my selfishness Lord Hideyoshi...<65535>
You're earlier than I expected Mitsunari... Sorry, Dark<65534>King. <65535>
You know I just really gotta ask. You still get to be<65534>king if you loose the castle?<65535>
What the hell are you doing here, Kanbe?<65535>
I thought I told you... You were full of yourself and<65534>not preparing for an actual fight. So I attacked your<65534>rear and won.<65535>
You know damn well that's not what I meant.<65535>
Kanbe! You will gain nothing!  Your a mongrel rolling<65534>in your filth!<65530><306><65533>Your presence defiles the spirit and integrity of<65534>my Lord castle! Prepare for punishment!<65535>
I bet it seems like you've had nothing but<65534>disappointments since you began your travels. So, got<65534>anything to say for yourself, oh Dark King?<65535>
Would it matter? I don't deny that the road has been<65534>difficult to walk. But I know all that I need to know<65534>about you! <65535>
All the evil I have faced... All of it can find it's<65534>origins in your heart! Yes! I find you guilty! You<65534>filthy beast!<65535>
So your calling me a filthy beast? Heh! You may have a<65534>point. But the path you've walked was your own, right?<65534>I think that puts the blame squarely on your shoulders.<65535>
I said it from the start. As a successor, you're a<65534>total disaster. <65535>
And Hideyoshi Toyotomi was nothing more than a shameful<65534>old fool! <65535>
He said that I am unfit to inherit my Lord's command...<65534>That I am nothing but a disgrace to my Lord... Is that<65534>all? Is that every accusation? Is it?<65535>
I will show him what I am... He will learn why I have<65534>been chosen to be the right hand of my Lord! <65535>
Just you watch. He will see my works and tremble! <65535>
But sir... You don't have any enemies left within the<65534>bounds of our country. To whom will you be trying to<65534>prove your might? <65535>
It's obvious! to the world! I will extend Lord<65534>Hideyoshi's will... To the ends of the earth!<65535>
I will finish out his works. And he will be<65534>immortalized the world over. He will look upon me...<65534>And know that I was a faithful!<65535>
Ieyasu Tokugawa... We hereby join you in alliance.<65535>
Hear us now! We are the Saica faction! The Red Bell<65534>rings. The pact we have made shall be known to all!<65530><446><65533>Let it toll! Let the Bell call out across the land!<65535>
Magoichi... May I ask you a question?<65535>
It's Mitsunari. I thought he might have...<65535>
You came to the Saica...as I did!<65535>
None of that matters anymore. Prepare yourself Ieyasu,<65534><95>I'm going to kill you, here and now!!But you...<65535>
...Magoichi Saica... You stay out of this!<65535>
You forget this is our land, and you are an intruder.<65535>
Leave. I shall teach him some manners.<65535>
Do not mistake my demand for kindness. This is our<65534>land. And we'll defend it.<65535>
Of course. <65535>
Next time... <65535>
Ieyasu! Don't you dare run away!<65535>
Those eyes of yours... I'd know them anywhere. The<65534>rightful owner of those eyes has taken ill. And now<65534>they adorn another... It begs many questions.<65535>
Tell me... how you've come to have such eyes?<65535>
Lord Shingen taught me many things. The value of<65534>discipline and of strategy. Even the value of defeat.<65530><665><65533>He is my mentor, now and always. I am ever in his debt.<65535>
If my eyes resemble the Tiger's... it's because they<65534>shine with his wisdom.<65535>
Though illness has stolen Shingen's health, his spirit<65534>endures... here on this battlefield.<65535>
Now prepare! Prove yourself and let the Tiger's spirit<65534>shine!<65535>
No less than what I had expected! You and your mighty<65534>fists...<65535>
...and my baton! Where would we be without it?<65535>
You'd best mind your head Dark King! Soon I'll send you<65534>spiraling into the netherworld!<65535>
Yoshiaki... I intend to let Mitsunari keep his head.<65535>
What nonsense is that?!  You want to win the battle,<65534>don't you?!<65535>
Yes. And I will.<65535>
Well, if that's the case, you have be realistic about<65534>it.<65535>
Realistic... <65535>
Look at me. Do I seem delusional?<65535>
No, uh...upon reflection, you're the very picture of<65534>clarity. And, that said...I shall take my leave of you!<65535>
That was close...<65535>
Well, I guess that'll have to do...<65535>
One-Eyed Dragon... I would be honored to fight at your<65534>side. We could use someone like you.<65535>
Spare me the flattery. You beat me fairly. Well, until<65534>next time...<65535>
One-Eyed Dragon...<65535>
Would you ever...forgive Mitsunari his deeds?<65535>
Forgive...? Don't know...<65535>
Just remember such an indulgence... is within your<65534>power.<65535>
Guess that could be. Guess we'll have to see how I'm<65534>feeling...when that bastard's kneeling vanquished at my<65534>feet.<65535>
Yes... One of us will lose and perish... and I will<65534>make sure it's not me...! No matter what!<65535>
Though you have assembled a mighty army... And though<65534>you have spoken you pretty speeches... Even now... I<65534>still see right through you.<65535>
Ieyasu... Your sins have found you out!<65535>
Mitsunari...<65535>
Now... Bow down in reverence to Lord Hideyoshi!  Beg<65534>his forgiveness for your crimes! And then, offer up<65534>your life as penance!<65535>
I cannot. My cause is righteous.<65535>

It always has to be this way dealing with you, doesn't<65534>it?<65530><307><65533>You ignore your own ambitions Pretending to cling<65534>to your moral superiority While challenging Lord<65534>Hideyoshi's dreams of unification!<65535>
You are deluded, Mitsunari! But know this...! I will<65534>unite this country with or without you!<65535>

How much will it take before your satisfied!? How<65534>much?! Even the very last of my allies you woo to your<65534>side with your forked tongue!<65530><742><65533>How am I supposed to live? What am I supposed to do now?!<65535>
Mark well my words... I will never surrender, Ieyasu.<65534>Even if I find myself alone... even when I lay gasping<65534>on my deathbed...<65535>
I will never forgive you!<65535>
Lord Ieyasu...<65535>
Brave warriors... grant me but one moment.<65535>
But...my lord...<65535>
I'm alright.<65535>
As you wish.<65535>
I've devoted my life to his Lordship Hideyoshi. As a<65534>member of the Toyotomi... you should, too.<65535>
How can you say such a thing? A man's life is his own.<65534>Why live it as his Lordship's pawn? <65535>
I had thought you would appreciate the virtue of<65534>loyalty. I was wrong. There's nothing left to say. <65535>
Mitsunari, you're making too much of this, my friend...<65535>
Then bow your head in apology. Your pride is unseemly.<65535>
Mitsunari, my debasing myself does you no honor.<65535>
You prefer your hollowed-out words and empty ideas? Is<65534>that all you're worth, Ieyasu?<65535>
Mitsunari, watch out!<65535>
Why did you save me?! Do you think I can't defend<65534>myself?!<65535>
Begone! May you die alone like a dog!<65535>
Hateful words... How can you speak them so easily?<65535>
As I struggled with the weight of my duty... I thought<65534>I heard a voice, calling out my name from the skies...<65535>
The skies...?<65535>
Yes... and it set me onto my present path. But who can<65534>tell? That voice was...<65535>
I followed the voice to you, the light by which we are<65534>led. If anybody has the strength and wisdom to heal<65534>this scorched land... I'm sure it's you. <65535>
